sloka: एवम् शापम् मयि न्यस्य विलप्य करुणम् बहु ।चितामारोप्य देहम् तन्मिथुनम् स्वर्गमभ्ययात् ॥२-६४-५८॥
transliteration: evam śāpam mayi nyasya vilapya karuṇam bahu ।citāmāropya deham tanmithunam svargamabhyayāt ॥2-64-58॥

translations.english: Having thus cursed me, the couple piteously lamenting for a long time, laid themselves down on the funeral pyre and went to heaven.
